# Storytelling @ Stage 11 — Abstract Emerge

> developed 2026-07-24.

## Crosswalk (from unified ladder)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| IST Stage# | 11 |
| Canonical name | Abstract Emerge |
| Altitude | `orange` (Worldcentric emerging) |
| MHC Order | 10 (Abstract) |
| Kegan | 3→4 |
| Identity band | Worldcentric emerging |

## Expression on this line

Storytelling capacity at Order 10 is performance mastery: expert-level delivery depth that
operates beyond conscious rule-following, producing performance that transcends inherited
tradition. The master performer who can improvise within the delivery canon, innovate beyond
it, and teach others to do the same.

The key advance over Stage 10 is that performance capacity is now *abstract* — it can be
reasoned about as a general phenomenon (what makes performance mastery possible? what enables
delivery innovation?) rather than just experienced in specific contexts.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** the felt fluency of expert performance — the master who works beyond conscious
  rule-following.
- **UR:** the capacity to innovate within and beyond inherited tradition, producing genuinely
  new performance expressions.
- **LL:** a performance culture that values mastery and innovation.
- **LR:** the institutional structures (performance training programs, master classes) that
  support performance mastery.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** mastery as ego — the master performer who becomes identified with their
  expertise.
- **Dark allergy:** mastery absence — the individual who cannot develop expert-level delivery
  depth.
- **Golden addiction:** claiming to have achieved formal performance modeling (Stage 12) while
  actually just demonstrating expert performance experience.
- **Golden allergy:** refusing to engage with performance mastery because it seems "elitist."

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Expert-level delivery depth:** the individual demonstrates mastery that operates beyond
  conscious rule-following.
- **Performance innovation:** the individual produces genuinely new work that transcends
  inherited tradition.
- **Teaching capacity:** the master can transmit their performance expertise to others.

## Sources, joints, open questions

**Sources:** Goffman, *Frame Analysis* (expert performance as frame management); Fischer-
Lichte, *The Transformative Power of Performance* (expert performance as transformative
practice).
**Open joints:** How does performance mastery shade into formal performance modeling
(Stage 12)?
**Research debt:** pairs with `10-concrete-peak` (complex performance integration) and
`12-formal-landmark` (formal performance modeling).
